operator_handoff.completion_signal: template_only is false only after real evidence exists; ledger_reviewer_approved, ledger_reviewer, and ledger_reviewed_at stay unset until reviewer approval.
operator_handoff.blocking_condition: Raw prompts, outputs, transcripts, credentials, or private content must not be included.

operator_handoff.label: Validate intake contract
operator_handoff.completion_signal: world_class_evidence_intake reports valid submissions and no invalid packets before reviewer approval.
operator_handoff.blocking_condition: A valid packet is ready for ledger review but is not accepted evidence by itself.

operator_handoff.label: Review submission queue
operator_handoff.completion_signal: world_class_submission_review shows ready-for-ledger-review before reviewer identity, timestamp, and approval are set.
operator_handoff.blocking_condition: Reviewer queue output is advisory and cannot accept evidence.

operator_handoff.label: Refresh evidence ledger
operator_handoff.completion_signal: world_class_evidence_ledger accepts the evidence entry with valid source checks.
operator_handoff.blocking_condition: Ledger remains the only world-class readiness source of truth.

operator_handoff.label: Guard public claim
operator_handoff.completion_signal: world_class_claim_guard allows the public readiness claim.
operator_handoff.blocking_condition: Public world-class claims stay blocked until every ledger entry is accepted.
